memberships.name: End Overdose
memberships.reason: Direct life-preserving mechanism and existing report provide a useful national-vs-local harm-reduction comparator despite CA dilution.
memberships.materialFalsifier: Whole-org national allocation may leave little CA benefit; kit substitution, use and subsequent mortality determine gains.
